description: Take one of the workspace's recipes out of recipe_list (library status retired). No version is deleted; library_update with action restore brings it back. If it was an account's default, that default is cleared and the account ids are returned.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: recipe_archive
title: Archive a recipe
